desire_meter.name: Desire Meter
desire_meter.idea: Apni wants plan karo. Dabi hui wants phat padti hain — planned treat impulse splurge se sasta padta hai.
desire_meter.how1: Meter har saal badhta hai, aur har baar jab tum Save ya Invest karte ho (khud ko rokte ho).
desire_meter.how2: Meter 50+ pe Spend = planned treat: meter wapas 0, lifestyle creep nahi.
desire_meter.how3: Meter 100 pe pahuncha toh agle saal impulse splurge: net worth ka 15% gaya.

saving_streak.name: Saving Streak
saving_streak.idea: Pehle khud ko pay karo. Har saal thoda-thoda, kabhi-kabhi badi rakam se better hai.
saving_streak.how1: Har saal jab tum Save ya Invest karte ho, streak 1 badhti hai.
saving_streak.how2: Har naye saal Auto-SIP tumhare index fund mein jaata hai — lambi streak, bada SIP (5 pe max).
saving_streak.how3: Ek Spend se streak toot jaati hai aur Auto-SIP ruk jaata hai.

lifestyle_creep.name: Lifestyle Creep aur Slots
lifestyle_creep.idea: Income badhe toh lifestyle ko saath mein mat badhne do — raise ko kuch achhe assets mein lagao.
lifestyle_creep.how1: Har saal salary milti hai 10% raise ke saath — par lifestyle chupke se har saal 5% zyada kha jaata hai.
lifestyle_creep.how2: Spend: lifestyle +12%. Save = budget review: lifestyle −10%.
lifestyle_creep.how3: Sirf 3 investment slots (alag-alag assets). Quality chuno: index fund, equity, debt.

grihastha.name: Family Goals aur Insurance
grihastha.idea: Pata hue goals ka paisa safe jagah ready rakho, aur bade health shocks insurance pe chhodo.
grihastha.how1: Saal 4: ghar ka down payment. Saal 7: bachchon ki padhai. Cash, FD ya debt fund se bharo.
grihastha.how2: Ready money kam? Investments jaldi mein bikenge aur kami pe 20% extra lagega.
grihastha.how3: Boss, saal 9: parents hospital mein (net worth ka 20%). Health insurance equipped = sirf paanchva hissa tum bharoge.

faq.title: Aksar puchhe jaane wale sawaal
faq.a1: BHAO ek competitive, multiplayer money card game hai jo real Indian economy jaisa feel deta hai. Players SIP, IPO boom aur achanak market crash jaisi real situations face karte hain. Goal: dusre players ke attacks se bachte hue sabse pehle ₹50 lakh jodna.
faq.q2: Stock simulator kaise kaam karta hai?
faq.a2: Normal stock simulators se alag, BHAO events pe chalta hai. Players "Decision Cards" lete hain jahan safe saving ya risky investing mein se chunna hota hai. Achha investment = high return, par pura paisa doobne ka risk bhi. Special "Action Cards" se players pure market pe asar daalne wale events chala sakte hain.
faq.a3: Haan, BHAO bilkul free hai. Account banao, wealth banao, Mogul rank ladder chadho aur multiplayer rooms mein dosto se compete karo — zero cost. Game ka focus hai khel-khel mein paise ki samajh badhana.

privacyDoc.intro: BHAO ("hum") ek financial-literacy card game hai jo aap browser mein ya BHAO Android app ke roop mein khel sakte ho. Ye page batata hai ki app kaunsi info handle karta hai, kyun, aur aapke paas kya choices hain. Koi sawaal? <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

guest.title: Guest ban ke khelna
guest.p1: Aap bina account ke tutorial, campaign, practice games aur Gyaan Library khel sakte ho. Guest mode mein hum apne servers pe koi account nahi banate. Ek random guest naam, aapki campaign progress aur aapki Gyaan Library progress sirf aapke device pe save hoti hai.
guest.p2: Jab aap baad mein usi device pe sign in karte ho, toh app ek baar ye guest progress aapke account mein copy karne ka option de sakta hai. Sirf agar aap haan bolte ho, tabhi aapke complete kiye campaign levels (stars aur best net worth) aur aapke unlock kiye Gyaan Library topics humare servers pe bheje jaate hain aur aapke account ke saath save hote hain, saath mein ek note ki import kab hua. Agar aap mana karte ho, toh kuch nahi bheja jaata.

account.title: Account banane pe hum kya info lete hain
account.details: Account details: aapka email address aur password (sirf hashed form mein save). Agar aap "Sign in with Google" use karte ho, toh Google aapka email address, naam, profile picture ka link aur Google account ID humare sign-in provider ke saath share karta hai. Hum email address se aapka account pehchaante hain; game aapka Google naam ya picture nahi dikhata.
account.profile: Profile: aapka username aur aapka chuna hua avatar. Avatars app mein pehle se bani pictures hain, toh aap kabhi koi photo upload nahi karte.
account.stats: Game data: kitne games khele aur jeete, win streaks, rank points, XP, in-game coins, aapki daily login date aur streak, daily-reward aur contract progress, aur aapke virtual stock holdings.
account.matches: Match history: har match ka mode, wo kab start aur end hua, aapka result aur final net worth, aapne kitne coins, XP aur rank points jeete ya gawaaye, aur game mein aapki choices ke stats.
account.campaign: Campaign progress: har level ke stars aur best net worth, aapne use kab complete kiya, aur kya wo guest play se import hua tha.
account.library: Gyaan Library progress: aapne kaunse topics unlock kiye aur khole, aur kab. Isse aapki library doosre devices pe bhi aapke saath rehti hai.
account.multiplayer: Multiplayer: aapke banaye ya join kiye rooms, aapki seat, game state (aapke cards bhi) aur ek "last seen" time jo dikhata hai ki aap abhi bhi connected ho ya nahi.
account.shown: Aapka username, avatar aur game stats doosre players ko dikh sakte hain, jaise leaderboards pe aur multiplayer rooms mein.
account.logs: Kisi bhi online service ki tarah, har request ke saath humare servers ko aapke device ka IP address aur basic browser ya device info milti hai, aur hum ise short-lived technical logs mein rakhte hain jo service chalane aur use protect karne ke liye use hote hain.
account.noPayment: BHAO mein real money se koi purchase nahi hota, isliye hum kabhi payment info collect nahi karte.

chat.title: Voice chat, text chat aur pokes
chat.voice: Voice chat aur microphone: multiplayer rooms mein aap chaho toh voice chat join kar sakte ho. App microphone permission tabhi maangta hai jab aap join karne ke liye tap karte ho, aur aap kabhi bhi khud ko mute kar sakte ho ya leave kar sakte ho. Voice seedha players ke devices ke beech jaati hai (peer-to-peer, encrypted). Hum ise na record karte hain, na store karte hain. Kisi bhi peer-to-peer call ki tarah, connected rehne tak doosre players ke devices aapka network (IP) address dekh sakte hain. Agar direct connection possible na ho, toh ek relay server encrypted audio aage pass kar sakta hai; wo use sun nahi sakta aur store nahi karta.
chat.text: Text chat, quick chat aur pokes: ye usi room ke players ko live bheje jaate hain aur humare servers pe store nahi hote. Room chhodte hi ye gayab ho jaate hain. Links aur lambe numbers hide ho jaate hain aur common gaaliyan automatically mask ho jaati hain.
chat.mute: Aap room mein kisi bhi player ko mute kar sakte ho. Mute karne se aapke liye unki chat aur pokes hide ho jaate hain aur unki voice band ho jaati hai.

reports.title: Players ko report karna
reports.p1: Aap room chat se kisi player ko report kar sakte ho. Ek report mein ye store hota hai: kisne report kiya, kisko report kiya, room, time, chuna gaya reason, jo bhi details type ki, aur reported player ke recent chat messages (max 10, jaise wo reporter ke device pe dikhe the), taaki hum check kar sakein ki kya hua. Voice kabhi report ka part nahi hoti kyunki wo record hi nahi hoti.
reports.p2: Reports sirf humari moderation team dekh sakti hai; reported player ko nahi bataya jaata ki kisne report kiya. Hum reports ka use rules todne wale players ko warn, suspend ya ban karne ke liye karte hain. Hum report tab tak rakhte hain jab tak case handle karne aur baar-baar hone wale abuse ko pakadne ke liye zaroorat ho, aur kisi bhi ek player ka account delete hone pe wo delete ho jaati hai.

errors.title: Error tracking
errors.p1: Agar error tracking on hai, toh hum crash aur error reports paane ke liye Sentry use karte hain, jaise error message, aap kaunsi screen pe the, aur aapka browser, operating system aur device type. Hum isme aapka account ID, username ya email address nahi jodte, aur Sentry aise set hai ki wo aapka IP address ya cookies na bheje.
errors.p2: Jab koi error aata hai, toh Sentry usse just pehle ki screen activity ka ek chhota replay bhi rakh sakta hai, taaki hum bug reproduce kar sakein; text aur input fields masked rehte hain. Lagbhag har 10 mein se 1 visit pe Sentry performance timings bhi record karta hai, jaise screens load hone mein kitna time lagta hai. Sentry ye data ek limited time ke baad automatically delete kar deta hai.

device.title: Aapke device pe store data
device.intro: Hum ye cheezein yaad rakhne ke liye aapke device ka local storage use karte hain (advertising cookies nahi):
device.session: aapka sign-in session (Supabase manage karta hai);
device.prefs: aapki language, sound aur reduced-motion settings;
device.progress: aapka guest naam, aur aapki tutorial, campaign aur Gyaan Library progress (guests ke liye, aur signed-in players ke liye ek copy ke roop mein);
device.flags: chhote flags, jaise ki kya aapne guest progress import karne wale offer ka jawaab pehle hi de diya hai;
device.cache: website pe, cached app files taaki BHAO jaldi load ho aur offline bhi chale (service worker).
device.end: Ye data aapke device pe tab tak rehta hai jab tak aap app ka storage ya browser ka site data clear nahi karte, ya app uninstall nahi karte. Sign out karne se sign-in session hat jaata hai.

services.title: Third-party services
services.supabase: Supabase: sign-in, database, aur wo live connection jo multiplayer moves, chat aur voice set-up messages le jaata hai.
services.google: Google: optional "Sign in with Google", aur STUN servers jo voice chat ke liye players ke devices ko ek-doosre ko dhoondhne mein help karte hain (wo aapka IP address dekhte hain, aapka audio kabhi nahi).
services.relay: Ek voice relay (TURN) service, sirf agar hum use on karein: direct connection fail hone pe ye players ke beech encrypted voice pass karti hai.
services.p1: Ye providers humari taraf se data process karte hain aur ise India ke bahar bhi store kar sakte hain.
services.p2: Fonts aur avatar pictures app mein hi bane hain, isliye unhe dikhane ke liye kisi aur website se contact nahi kiya jaata. Agar aap friends ko invite karne ke liye WhatsApp button use karte ho, toh invite text (room code ke saath) WhatsApp ko diya jaata hai, jo phir apne khud ke terms ke under kaam karta hai.

dont.title: Hum kya nahi karte
dont.p1: Hum aapka personal data nahi bechte aur ads nahi dikhate. Hum advertising ID use nahi karte, aur aapki location, contacts, photos ya files access nahi karte. BHAO mein real money se koi purchase nahi hota aur sirf virtual coins use hote hain; hum kabhi bank, UPI ya payment details nahi maangte. Hum voice chat record nahi karte aur text chat store nahi karte. Game mein kuch bhi financial advice nahi hai.

retention.title: Data rakhna aur delete karna
retention.p1: Jab tak aapka account hai, hum aapka account data rakhte hain.
retention.p2: Aap apna account kabhi bhi app mein {{profile}} → {{button}} se, ya {{email}} pe email karke delete kar sakte ho. App mein delete karna turant hota hai: humare servers pe aapka account, profile aur aapka saara game data hamesha ke liye delete ho jaata hai, jisme match history, campaign aur Gyaan Library progress, guest-import note, aapki ki hui reports aur aapke baare mein ki gayi reports shaamil hain. Email requests 30 din ke andar complete hoti hain. Steps aur details: Apna BHAO account delete karo.
retention.p3: Humare database provider ke backups mein copies thode time tak reh sakti hain jab tak wo overwrite na ho jaayein. Error reports Sentry ek limited time tak rakhta hai aur phir automatically delete ho jaati hain; wo aapke account se linked nahi hoti.
retention.p4: Aapke device pe store data (settings, guest progress, cached progress) humare servers pe nahi hai. Ise hatane ke liye app ka storage ya browser ka site data clear karo, ya app uninstall karo.

rights.title: Aapke rights
rights.p1: Aap kahan rehte ho uske hisaab se (India ke Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ke under bhi), aapko apna personal data access karne, correct karne ya erase karwane ka, aur grievance (shikayat) raise karne ka right ho sakta hai. <mail>{{email}}</mail> pe email karo aur hum reasonable time mein reply karenge.

children.title: Bachche
children.p1: BHAO use karne ke liye aapki umar kam se kam {{age}} saal honi chahiye, kyunki multiplayer rooms mein aap doosre players ke saath, strangers bhi, voice aur text chat kar sakte ho. BHAO {{age}} saal se chhote bachchon ke liye nahi bana hai aur hum jaan-boojh ke unka data collect nahi karte. Agar humein pata chale ki koi account {{age}} saal se kam umar wale ka hai, toh hum use delete kar dete hain. Jin parents ya guardians ko lagta hai ki unke bachche ne account banaya hai, wo use delete karwane ke liye humse contact kar sakte hain.
children.minors: Agar aapki umar 18 se kam hai, toh please BHAO sirf parent ya guardian ki consent se use karo.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: Jab humare practices badlenge, hum ye page update karenge aur upar di gayi "Last update" date badal denge.

termsDoc.intro: Ye terms tab laagu hote hain jab aap BHAO use karte ho, browser mein ya Android app ke roop mein. Khel ke aap inse agree karte ho. Koi sawaal? <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

game.title: Game
game.p1: BHAO entertainment aur financial-literacy education ke liye ek card game hai. Game ke scenarios, returns aur market events simple banaye gaye hain aur fictional hain. BHAO mein kuch bhi financial, investment, tax ya legal advice nahi hai. Real financial decisions lene se pehle kisi qualified professional se baat karo.

virtual.title: Virtual items
virtual.p1: BHAO mein real money se koi purchase nahi hota. In-game coins sirf khel ke kamaye jaate hain. Coins, rank points, XP, stars aur cards ki real world mein koi money value nahi hai, inhe paison ke liye khareeda, becha ya exchange nahi kiya ja sakta, aur ye aapki property nahi hain. BHAO gambling nahi hai. Hum inhe adjust ya reset kar sakte hain, jaise bugs fix karne ya game balance karne ke liye.

account.title: Aapka account
account.age: BHAO use karne ke liye aapki umar kam se kam {{age}} saal honi chahiye.
account.minors: Agar aapki umar 18 se kam hai, toh aapko parent ya guardian ki permission chahiye.
account.login: Apni login details safe rakho; aapke account pe jo bhi activity hoti hai uski zimmedari aapki hai.
account.username: Aisa username chuno jo offensive na ho, kisi aur ki nakal (impersonation) na kare, aur kisi ke rights ka ullanghan na kare.
account.guest: Guest progress sirf aapke device pe rehti hai. Agar account mein copy karne se pehle aap app ka data clear kar do ya device kho do, toh wo wapas nahi aa sakti.
account.delete: Aap apna account kabhi bhi app mein apni profile se, ya email se delete kar sakte ho (<deleteLink>kaise, ye dekho</deleteLink>).

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.p1: Cheating mat karo, bugs ka galat fayda mat uthao, bots ya scripts use mat karo, doosre players ko harass mat karo, aur service ko todne ya overload karne ki koshish mat karo. Aisa karne wale accounts ko hum suspend ya delete kar sakte hain.

community.title: Chat, voice aur reporting
community.intro: Multiplayer chat aur voice mein respect se raho. Ye mat karo:
community.abuse: kisi ko gaali dena, dhamkana, bully karna ya kisi ke against hate speech;
community.sexual: sexual content share karna ya maangna;
community.scams: spam, advertising, ya scams chalana (jaise UPI ID, OTP, password ya paise maangna);
community.personal: apni ya kisi aur ki personal info share karna (phone number, address, school waghera).
community.p2: Kisi player ko sunna ya dekhna band karne ke liye mute button, aur humein unke baare mein batane ke liye report button use karo. Report mein us player ke recent chat messages hote hain (voice record nahi hoti). Hum reports review karte hain aur in rules ko todne wale accounts ko warn, suspend ya delete kar sakte hain.

availability.title: Availability
availability.p1: BHAO "jaisa hai waisa" (as is) diya jaata hai. Hum ise chalu rakhne ki koshish karte hain par promise nahi kar sakte ki ye hamesha available rahega, error-free rahega, ya progress kabhi lose nahi hogi. Online features badal sakte hain ya band ho sakte hain.

liability.title: Liability
liability.p1: Jitna kanoon allow karta hai, us had tak hum indirect losses ke liye ya game ke basis pe liye gaye aapke decisions ke liye zimmedar nahi hain. In terms mein kuch bhi laagu consumer law ke under aapke rights ko limit nahi karta.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Hum aapka data kaise handle karte hain, ye jaanne ke liye humari <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> dekho.

changes.title: Changes aur laagu kanoon
changes.p1: Hum ye terms update kar sakte hain; update ke baad bhi use karte rehne ka matlab hai ki aap use accept karte ho. Ye terms India ke kanoonon ke under chalte hain.

hook.title: Tumhari daily chai {{amount}} ki ho sakti hai.
hook.perMonth: har mahine, SIP mein lagao toh
hook.fine: Isme {{paidIn}} tumhara apna paisa hai; baaki {{growth}} compounding se aata hai. {{rate}}% Indian index funds ka long-term average hai, guarantee nahi — kuch saal girte hain, kuch saal uchhalte hain.
hook.lead: Chalo dekhte hain paisa asli mein kaise badhta hai. Rahul ke saath 4 saal ka mini match — bas 5 minute.

invest.title: Jaldi invest karo, baaki kaam time karega
invest.body: Pada hua cash inflation se har saal ~6% ghatta hai. Index fund market ke saath badhta hai — saal upar-neeche, decades strong.

emergency.title: Emergency fund bana lo
emergency.body: Achanak kharche ke liye cash ho toh investments jaldi mein nahi bechne padte — Rahul ne flat bechne pe 15% penalty bhari.

insure.title: Bade risks ka insurance lo
insure.body: Health insurance ne hospital bill ₹0 kar diya. BHAO mein defense lagana free hai aur turn khatam nahi hota.

scam.title: “Guaranteed returns” = red flag
scam.body: Hot tips aur paisa-double schemes doob jaati hain. Invest karne se pehle SEBI/RBI registration check karo.

nudge.playChai: Is lesson ke liye “{{card}}” khelo — roz ₹150 wala card.
nudge.decisionSave: Koi decision card khelo aur Save chuno.
nudge.equipFirst: Pehle Health Insurance lagao — free hai aur turn chalta rahega.
nudge.chooseInvest: Is lesson ke liye Invest chuno.
nudge.chooseSave: Save chuno — pehle cash buffer banao.
nudge.defenseSoon: Defense cards thodi der mein aayenge.
nudge.oneEquip: Ek turn mein ek hi free equip.
nudge.noPass: Pass karne se card hatega aur turn khatam — abhi nahi.

networth.title: Tumhara paisa
networth.body: Net worth = cash + investments. Tum {{cash}} cash se shuru karte ho, koi investment nahi. BHAO ka har round tumhari life ka ek saal hai. Net worth ko {{goal}} tak le jao.

rival.title: Milo {{name}} se
rival.body: Rahul ki net worth bhi {{netWorth}} hai, par usme {{flat}} ka flat hai aur cash sirf {{cash}}. Woh har bacha rupaya invest kar deta hai, emergency fund zero. Uspe nazar rakho.

pickChai.title: Ek card khelo
pickChai.body: Har turn mein ek card khelte ho. Yeh card roz chai-snacks pe jaane wale ₹150 ka hai — matlab mahine ke ₹4,500.

preview.title: Save, Spend ya Invest?
preview.body: Har choice dikhati hai ki abhi paise pe kya asar hoga. Save se cash badhta hai. Spend se cash ghatta hai aur lifestyle mehengi hoti hai. Invest se cash investment mein jaata hai — aaj net worth same rehti hai, phir har saal badhti (ya girti) hai.

invest.title: Invest kar do
invest.body: Index fund mein India ki top companies ka thoda-thoda hissa hota hai. Invest se tumhare {{amount}} cash isme jaayenge — turant profit nahi, saal-dar-saal badhta hai.
invest.bodyPart: Index fund mein India ki top companies ka thoda-thoda hissa hota hai. Invest se tumhare cash ka kuch hissa isme jaayega — turant profit nahi, saal-dar-saal badhta hai.

botTurn.title: Rahul ki baari
botTurn.body: Tum ek card khelte ho, phir turn khatam. Ab Rahul khelega — woh apna cash aur property mein daalta hai.

year.title: Ek saal nikal gaya
year.market: Market hila: tumhara index fund {{pct}} gaya, {{from}} → {{to}}.
year.inflation: Inflation ({{pct}}% saalana) ne tumhare pade hue cash se {{amount}} kha liye: daam badhe, toh utne hi rupaye mein kam aata hai. Pada hua cash chupchaap ghatta hai.
year.inflationSome: Inflation ({{pct}}% saalana) ne tumhare pade hue cash ka kuch hissa kha liya: daam badhe, toh utne hi rupaye mein kam aata hai. Pada hua cash chupchaap ghatta hai.

lure.title: Life event: ek “hot tip”
lure.body: Har saal koi life event aa sakta hai. Rahul ko WhatsApp pe tip mili — “har mahine guaranteed 30%!” — aur usne {{amount}} laga diye. Dekhte hain kya hota hai.
lure.bodyNoAmount: Har saal koi life event aa sakta hai. Rahul ko WhatsApp pe tip mili — “har mahine guaranteed 30%!” — aur usne paisa laga diya. Dekhte hain kya hota hai.

pickSave.title: Buffer rakho
pickSave.body: Tumhare paas {{cash}} cash hai. Sab invest kar dena risky hai: life mein achanak bills aate hain. Thoda cash emergency fund ke liye rakho.

botTurn2.title: Save ho gaya!
botTurn2.body: Ab tumhare paas {{cash}} cash hai. Rahul khel raha hai — woh phir invest karta hai aur cash lagbhag zero.

medical.title: Medical emergency!
medical.head: Rahul phisal gaya aur hospital jaana pada.
medical.headBill: Rahul phisal gaya aur hospital jaana pada — uski net worth {{amount}} gir gayi.
medical.sold: Uske paas cash kam tha, toh jaldi mein flat ka hissa 15% penalty pe bechna pada.
medical.you: Tumhare paas {{cash}} cash hai, toh aisa bill cash se bhar jaayega aur investments badhte rahenge. Emergency fund isi liye hota hai.

equip.title: Insurance lo
equip.body: Tumhe Health Insurance mila. Defense cards ek type ki problem block karte hain — yeh medical bills block karta hai. Defense lagana free hai: turn khatam nahi hota.
equip.todo: Chamakte “{{card}}” card pe tap karo, phir 🛡️ Equip.

freePlay.title: Abhi bhi tumhari baari
freePlay.body: Insurance lag gaya. Is turn abhi bhi ek card khel sakte ho — tumhari marzi. Invest, Save ya Spend: ab pata hai kaun kya karta hai.

botTurn3.body: Rahul khelta hai. Phir ek aur saal nikalta hai…

scam.title: Hot tip ka paisa kahan gaya?
scam.wiped: Rahul ki “guaranteed” tip do saal lagatar giri aur ab poori doob gayi. “Guaranteed high return” = scam ka formula.
scam.crashing: Rahul ki “guaranteed” tip girti ja rahi hai. “Guaranteed high return” = scam ka formula.
scam.blocked: Aur is saal tumpe hospital bill aaya — Health Insurance ne block kar diya, tumne kuch nahi bhara.

goal.title: Goal kya hai
goal.p1: Rivals se pehle apni net worth goal tak le jao — ya saal khatam hone pe sabse ameer raho.
goal.p2: Ek round = life ka ek saal. Har saal sab ek-ek turn khelte hain.

cash.title: Cash vs investments
cash.p2: Haath mein {{hand}} cards hote hain. Har turn ek card khelo: Save (cash badhta hai), Spend (cash ghatta hai, lifestyle badhti hai) ya Invest (cash index fund, gold, property… mein jaata hai).
cash.p3: Defense lagana free hai ({{maxDefenses}} tak). Ya Pass karo: ek card hatao aur turn khatam.

year.title: Saal beet-ta hai
year.p1: Har investment market ke saath chalta hai: safe wale thoda, risky wale bahut — crash bhi hote hain.
year.p2: Inflation har saal pade hue cash ka lagbhag {{inflation}}% kha jaati hai (lifestyle pe kharcha karte raho toh aur zyada).
year.p3: Toh jo paisa abhi nahi chahiye, use invest karo — par thoda cash zaroor rakho.

events.title: Life events aur defense
events.p1: Zyada-tar saal kuch na kuch hota hai: bonus, hospital bill, job gap, “guaranteed” scam tip…
events.p2: Bills cash se bharte hain. Cash nahi hai? Toh investments jaldi mein penalty pe bikte hain. Isliye emergency fund rakhte hain.
events.p3: Health Insurance jaise defense cards poori category ki problems block kar dete hain.
